title: Mistral ships Voxtral 3, a voice-agent stack for calls in 50-plus languages
friendlyTitle: Mistral releases voice tools that can take a call in more than 50 languages
summary: Mistral has released Voxtral 3: speech-to-text and text-to-speech models, plus a voice-agent SDK that listens, calls tools, and speaks in one streaming pipeline. The company says Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 covers more than 50 languages, including who-spoke-when and keyphrase biasing, and that the Mini batch model is priced at $0.0035 a minute. Speech synthesis is priced at $13 per million characters, across more than 35 languages and 50 dialects. The stack is available on Mistral's API, including a European endpoint, or for self-deployment.
friendlySummary: Mistral has released Voxtral 3. It includes models that turn speech into text and text into speech, plus a kit for building a voice agent that listens, uses tools, and talks back in one stream. Mistral says the stronger transcription model covers more than 50 languages, can tell speakers apart, and can be nudged toward special words. The smaller batch model is priced at $0.0035 a minute. Spoken replies cost $13 per million characters. You can use Mistral's API, including a server in Europe, or run the stack yourself.
whyItMatters: A voice agent that can book an appointment or read a referral during a live call is now a priced product, not a demo reel. The accuracy claims are Mistral's. The practical choice is whether the audio stays on the company's API or on infrastructure you run yourself.
